label: Blind sample 086: Hansen forest loss 2022, tile 60N_100E

verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.15 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2022 (90% interval −0.18 to −0.09). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 2 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.05). Counted by gap size instead, 1 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.03).

evidence.sentence: Optical shows the change (greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.15); radar has too few observations to weigh in.

notes: kept cells whose dominant land cover is tree cover like the area
kept cells within 150 m of the area's elevation (378 m)
ranked by pre-event similarity; kept the best 80
